D5/S1/Words/AdmissibleWords/KBonacciEmit.signature: theorem prefix_coupling_emitted_tail {k n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (sites : List (Fin n)) (hn : sites.Nodup) (fixed : Finset (Fin n)) (hfree : ∀ i ∈ sites, i ∉ fixed) (x y : Fin n → Bool) (hx : (completions k n fixed x).Nonempty) (hy : (completions k n fixed y).Nonempty) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ sites.length) : mean (prefixCoupling sites fixed x y hx hy) (fun w => if ∀ i ∈ sites.take j, ¬ (w.1 i = false ∧ w.2 i = false) then 1 else 0) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞)^j
